tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: tshe sgrub rdo rje'i phreng ba las: tshe bdag yab yum sras gsum gyi: nang sgrub lung gi byang bu bzhugs:

ྈྈྈྈ bde chen 'gyur med sku la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: tshe sgrub gdams pa mtha' yas shes: kun gyis yang dril khyer bde ni: tshe bdag yab yum sras gsum gyi: nang sgrub spros med rlung sems de: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su blangs: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro dben pa'i gnas su 'dug: tho rangs rang nyid lus gnad bsrang: rlung ro bsal zhing rig pa bsgrim: dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro: 'gro phan byang chub mchog sems bskyed: tshogs gsag yan lag bdun pa bya: sgrib sbyong maṇ+ḍal spyi dang mthun: bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig bsgom: 1$0000250rang mdun nam mkha' 'od lnga'i klong: gu ru pad+ma tshe dpag med: yab yum bde chen gzi brjid 'bar: mngon sum bzhugs bsam mos gus bskyed: 1$0000300hrī: rje btsun o rgyan rin po che: rgyal ba'i dbang po tshe dpag med: 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po: mgon med bdag la thugs rjes zungs: bdag la re sa gzhan na med: skyid sdug re ltos khyed shes pas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: gsol ba rtse gcig btab pa yis: 1$0000250sbyor mtshams byang sems dkar dmar rgyun: gnas bzhir babs pas sgrib bzhi dag: dbang thob sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs: bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim: dbyer med gyur bsam ngang la bzhag: 1$0000300 sa ma ya: 1$0000250dngos gzhi chos kun stong par blta: oṃ las tshe dpag med du bsgom: oṃ dkar spro bsdus tshe bcud bsdu: yab la bsten pa'i tshe sgrub kyis: rdo rje'i sku ru bsgrub pa 'o: āṃḥlas lha mo tsan+ḍa bsgom: āṃḥdamar 'od zer spro bsdu bya: yum la bsten pa'i tshe sgrub ste: rdo rje'i srog tu bsgrub pa 'o: hūm̐ las thugs rje chen por bsgom: hūm̐ mthing 'od spros tshe bcud bsdu: sras la bsten nas tshe sgrub pas: 'chi med rdo rje'i thugs 'grub bo:

ting 'dzin me nyid ma gsal na: bzlas brjod rlung gi 'khrul 'khor bya: rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po: so so'i sngags kyi rang bzhin bsam: sngags gsum yid kyi bzlas pa bya: lto ba brgyangs la bar rlung bzung: sa ma ya: rjes ni dbyings dang rig pa bsre: dmigs med rang gsal sang nger bzhag: skye 'chi'i rtog pa dbyings su bcad: rig rtsal brtul zhugs thogs med kyis: 'chi bdag 'jigs pa zil gyis mnan: mi 'gyur 'pho med lta ba'i rgya: sa ma ya: 1$0000300 de gsum dril te bsgrub 'dod na: lam khyer lung gi byang bu yang: sngon dngos rjes kyi rim pas bstan: sngon 'gro gsum las mtshams gcod ni: hūm̐: rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid la: bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med: rdo rje me yi 'khor lo 'bar: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub: hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: glo bur 'khrul rtogs dbyings su bshags: hūm̐ hrī: snang srid rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing: phung khams sku dang ye shes nyid: ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i las bgyis pa: gnyis med blo 'das ngang du bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe a: snang yul ye shes mchod par brlab: hūm̐ hrī: snod bcud kun tu bzang po'i sprin: ye nas phyi nang gsang bar gnas: bde ba chen po'i longs spyod rnams: chos dbyings gang bar rgya cher spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos gzhi bskyed bzlas sgrub gsum las: dang po dam tshig dkyil 'khor bskyed: hūm̐ hrī: chos rnams sems nyid stong pa nyid: thams cad ye shes lhun gyis grub: gnyis med byang chub sems kyi dbyings: 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal: bh+rūm̐ badz+ra a yu ṣe bh+rūm̐: gzhom med zla gam 'bar ba ru: pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥdakar las: dbang chen rta mgrin shel gyi mdog: phyag gnyis thal sbyar tshe bum bsnams: hūm̐ las rta mgo steng phyogs su: bzhad sgra'i khroṃ las khyung nag pos: zla gam gnam sgo srung bar gyur:

spyi bor oṃ las tshe dpag med: dkar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: mgrin par āṃḥlas tsan+ḍa lī: me tog dmar po'i rgyan phreng can: zhi 'dzum g.yas pas rdo rje dang: g.yon pas dril bu tshe bum 'dzin: bcu drug lang tsho bde nyams can: pad+ma'i gdan la sems skyil bzhugs: thugs kar hūm̐ yig mthing ga las: sras mchog thugs rje chen po ni: mthing ga pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan: nyi ma'i gdan la sems skyil bzhugs: hūm̐ hrī: lus ngag yid gsum ma bcos pa: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su gsal: dug lnga ma spang rang sar dag: ye shes lnga ru lhun gyis grub: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: ye shes 'khor lo dgug cing bstim: hūm̐ hrī: ye nas gnyis su med pa'i dbyings: gzugs kyi skur bzhengs longs spyod rdzogs: 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rnams: nye bar dgongs te gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa mā dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: cir snang ye shes rol pas mchod: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen ye shes 'bar ba'i dpyid: ra sa yā na las byung ba'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: ji ltar 'char ba de ltar rol: sarba pū dza ho: rdo rje'i glu yis bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sgrib pa'i dri ma ma lus sel: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i gsung: gsung rab dam pa yi ge med: brjod du med cing spros bral ba: rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: shin tu rnam par dag pa'i thugs: chags med ye shes gnyis mkhyen pa: stong pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi: rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgo gsum gus pas brda don dran: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo yis: bstod pas rdo rje'i tshe 'grub bo:

sa ma ya: gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni: spyi bo'i tshe dpag med pa yi: thugs kar zla ba'i khang bu la: oṃ yig gnas pa'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor 'das tshe bcud oṃ du bsdus: oṃ la thim pas 'od zer 'bar: lo brgya thub pa'i tshe thob bsam: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: mgrin pa'i lha mo tsan+ḍa lī'i: thugs kar pad+ma kha sprod du: āṃḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros: 'khor 'das tshe bcud āṃḥdu bsdus: snying ga'i āṃḥl sib sib thim: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub bsam: oṃ dhā ki tsan+ḍa lī ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: snying ga'i thugs rje chen po yi: thugs kar nyi ma'i gur khyim du: hūm̐ mthing las ni 'od zer 'phros: 'khor 'das tshe bcud hūm̐ du bsdus: srog gi yi ger thim pa yis: 'chi med rdo rje'i tshe thob bsam: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ a yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐: rang las sprul pa'i khro chung tshogs: nam mkha' gang ba spros nas su: tshe bdud thams cad thal bar brlags: bla tshe 'khyams yar phrogs kun bsdus: nṛ yi rnam par rang la thim: tshe srog nyams pa sor chud nas: tshe dbang rig 'dzin 'grub par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: tshe bh+rūm̐ dzaḥ g.yu bh+rūm̐ dzaḥ a yur+dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha oṃ: zhes pa'i dmigs bzlas tshad du bskyal: nges par 'chi med 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: gsum pa tshe 'brang sgrub pa ni: tshe dang gal gyis bum gzugs bya: lung gi byang bu'i gzhung bsrang la: bh+rūm̐ las zla gam dmar po'i nang: tshe bdag zhi khro gang rung ngam: dril sgrub lha bzhi rdzogs par bsgom: bzlas pas 'od zer spro bsdu bya: mda' dar g.yab cing tshe bcud bsdu: bh+rūm̐: tshe yi zla gam gzhal yas nas: 'chi med lha mchog thugs dam bskul: sems kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i khams nas bcud sdus la: de bzhin rigs kyi tshe stsol cig: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na:

chu yi khams nas bcud sdus la: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe stsol cig: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na: sa yi khams nas bcud sdus la: rin chen rigs kyi tshe stsol cig: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud sdus la: pad+ma rigs kyi tshe stsol cig: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: rlung gi khams nas bcud sdus la: las kyi rigs kyi tshe stsol cig: tshe bskul 'khor 'das tshe bcud 'dus: bdud rtsi'i thig ler 'khyil bar bsam: de nas tshe yi dngos grub blang: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa ba'i bla ma yab gcig tshe dpag med: de yi yum mchog lha mo tsan+ḍa lī: thugs kyi sras mchog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: bka' yi pho nya rta mgrin bya khyung bcas: rtsa gsum tshe yi lha la gsol ba 'debs: dus min 'chi ba zlog par byin gyis rlobs: skye 'chi bgres rgud med pa'i tshe dbang stsol: oṃ āṃḥhūm̐ hrīḥkhroṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: tshe bdag lha tshogs rang thim bsam: tshe 'brang gnas gsum gtugs nas su: dngos grub bcud du bsam la rol: de yis rdo rje'i tshe 'grub 'gyur: sa ma ya: rjes rim gsum las tshogs mchod ni: bza' btung ci 'byor bdud rtsir brlab: hūm̐ hrī: gdod nas bdud rtsi lngar gnas pa'i: rmad du byung ba'i 'dod yon tshogs: thabs shes rol pa'i dam tshig rdzas: byang chub sems kyi rgyan du rol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: phud kyis mchod la lhag mas brngan: hūm̐ hrī: tshogs kyi 'du ba'i bgegs 'joms shing: gsang ba'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa'i: byang chub sems sprin bka' nyan rnams: bde chen longs spyod 'di rol la: zag med ye shes phrin las spel: 'du bar 'os min thams cad sgrol: pad+ma ḍā ki ni ma ma hring hriṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: lhar snang dbyings su bsdu zhing ldang: hūm̐ hrī: byang chub sems kyi dbyings nyid las: thams cad spro zhing 'du bar mdzad: 'od gsal dbyings su thams cad bsdu:

bde chen las shar 'gyur ba med: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bsngo smon shis brjod mtha' rgyas bya: hūm̐ hrī: byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'gyur ba med par lhun gyis grub: 'chi med rdo rje'i gnas thob nas: 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal du shog: hūm̐ hrī: 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i sku: 'gag pa med pa rdo rje'i gsung: 'khrul pa med pa rdo rje'i thugs: 'chi med rdo rje'i bkra shis shog: na mo hūm̐: zhes brjod lta ba'i ngang la bzhag: tshe sgrub lung gi byang bu 'o: sa ma ya: 1$0000250mtshan bcas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: dang po lha yi gsal snang bsten: de nas bum can rlung la sbyang: dngos gzhi'i nyams len rim pa gsum: rang lus thabs kyi tshe sgrub ni: phung khams yab tu dag pa yi: dbu ma srog shing tshul du gnas: yar sne yab kyi oṃ dkar po: mar sne yum gyi āṃ dmar po: srin zhal phye 'dzum rlung gis sbar: āṃḥgi me yis oṃ zhu bas: dbu ma byang sems dkar dmar khengs: yar mar rdo rje phyed pas mtshan: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i srog 'grub bsam: bde stong ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: gzhan lus yum la bsten pa ni: rigs ldan rgyud dag phyag rgya ma: tsan+ḍa lī yi sku ru bsgom: mkha' gsang pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus: āṃḥyig bsam la mnyam par sbyor: chags pa chen po'i 'od zer gyis: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud āṃḥl bsdu: de nyid rdo rje'i lam nas drangs: rang gi snying kha'i oṃ la bstim: bde stong ngang du mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: sras la bsten nas rgyud spel ba: rang gi snying gar sras bzhugs pa'i: thig le'i rang bzhin gnyis pa spros: yum gyi mkha' la bab pa las: yum gyi mkha' gsang zla gam sgo: khroṃ las khyung gis bsrung bar bsam: sems mchog bskyed cing smon lam gdab: gzhan don nus pa'i rigs rgyud 'byung: sa ma ya: 1$0000300 gsang ba zab mo'i smin byed ni: rdul tshon tshom bu gang 'grub kyi:

dkyil 'khor dbus su bum pa'i khar: mtshan ldan thod par dza gad bkang: me long li khri brdal ba la: chos 'byung bsnol ma āṃḥbris dgab: dar dmar gur phub shel rdo bkod: tshe 'brang tshe ril chang sogs dang: mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad bsham: bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas bya: khyad par tshe 'brang sgrub pa dang: tshe bcud bsdu zhing nus ldan bya: slob mar khrus bya bgegs mtshams bcad: maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab: bde chen dgyes par rol pa yi: bla ma 'chi med mgon po dgongs: zab mo'i bdud rtsi bla na med: de ring bdag la bstsal du gsol: lan gsum zhus te rgyud sbyong zhing: sdom gsum legs par bzung bar bya: lhar bskyed ye shes dbab cing brtan: nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams kyis: bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur bsam: oṃ: bum pa dbyings kyi gzhal yas su: ye shes lha tshogs 'od du zhu: dbang gi chu rgyun lus la zhugs: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog: badz+ra ka la sha kā ya a bhi ṣiñca ā+oṃ: yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems rgyun: thod par bskyil te myang bar bsam: āṃ: bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun: srid zhi'i dwangs bcud ngag la zhugs: gzhom med gsung du 'grub par shog: ma hā su kha gu h+ya wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āṃ: me long dal las tsan+ḍa lī: 'phros te snyoms zhugs bde skyes bsam: hūm̐: mtshan ldan tsan+ḍa lī'i ngo bo: phyag rgya'i reg bya la bsten nas: lhan skyes bde chen mtha' ru phyin: 'od gsal thugs su 'grub par shog: pra dz+nyā dz+nyā na tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: shel 'od rtsal dang ngo bo'i dpes: dbyings rig mtshon byas mnyam par bzhag: ho: dbyings kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong: rig pa ye shes ma 'gags gsal: zung 'jug kun bzang dgongs pa rtogs: skye 'chi'i 'dzin rtog rang grol shog: dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca a a a: tshe 'brang lus dkyil lha rnams gsal:

'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser 'phros: gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi po: rtsal rdzogs nyid du thob bsam la: dngos grub bskul ba'i gsol 'debs brjod: tshe yi 'brang rgyas gnas bzhir gtugs: lha rnams 'od zhu slob mar bstims: mtha' rten tshe ril tshe chang yang: bkra shis zhal bsro'i tshul du sbyin: dam tshig khas blang gtong rag 'bul: 'dis ni zab mo'i snod du rung: gnas skabs tshe yi dngos grub thob: mthar thug bde chen ye shes brnyes: nang sgrub rlung sngags dbyer med pa: lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa: zab cing gnad 'dril gsang ba'i bcud: skal ldan rnams kyi snying la phur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
